theme.description: Colours, corners, text and motion: seven bases, seventeen accents, six styles.

app.description: AshlarApp, the app shell on WidgetsApp, in place of MaterialApp; AshlarApp.router for go_router and the like.

pressable.description: Hover, press, keyboard focus and activation, and a press area big enough for a finger, for every control.

button.description: Six variants and five sizes, square or round, with icons either side and a badge.

badge.description: A small label: a status, a count, a tag.

card.description: A panel with a header, content and a footer.

ticket.description: A ticket: two halves on one card, bitten at the sides where they meet, with a line to tear along.

separator.description: A one-pixel line, across or down.

input.description: A text field with selection handles and a cut, copy and paste menu.

checkbox.description: A box that is ticked or not.

dialog.description: A modal panel over a dimmed page, with title, content and actions.

label.description: The name of a control, above it or beside it.

field.description: A control with its label, description and error, read out together.

textarea.description: A text field for several lines that grows with its text and drags taller.

avatar.description: A picture in a circle, with initials while it loads or when it fails.

skeleton.description: A pulsing placeholder in the shape of content still loading.

spinner.description: A turning ring that says something is working.

alert.description: A notice, warning or error in the page, read out when it appears.

kbd.description: A keyboard key, for showing shortcuts.

radio.description: A choice of one, in Flutter's RadioGroup, with labels.

tabs.description: Views of one thing, one at a time, chosen from a row of tabs.

popover.description: A panel that opens from a trigger and floats over the page.

dropdown-menu.description: A menu of actions from a trigger: checkbox and radio items, groups and submenus.

select.description: Picks one value from a list: groups, icons, type to find, and long lists.

tooltip.description: A short label over a control on hover, focus or long press.

toast.description: Short messages that go by themselves: types, promises and a stack.

group.description: Joins controls into one piece: Button Group and Toggle Group use it.

button-group.description: Buttons joined into one piece, for actions that belong together.

typography.description: Headings, paragraphs, quotes and lists in the theme's type.

empty.description: What to show when there is nothing here yet.

item.description: A row in a list: media, a title and description, and actions.

progress.description: How far along something is, as a bar.

breadcrumb.description: Where a page sits, as links to the pages above it, folding long trails.

collapsible.description: Content that opens and closes under a trigger.

accordion.description: Sections that open one at a time under their headings.

toggle.description: A button that stays pressed: bold, italic, or a filter as a chip.

toggle-group.description: Toggles joined into one piece, or chips set apart, one or several pressed.

slider.description: A value picked by dragging along a track, or with the arrow keys.

color-picker.description: Any colour, chosen by hand: a square for saturation and brightness, a hue strip, opacity if you like, the hex to type and swatches to start from, each part by pointer, keys or a screen reader; and a button that opens it.

pagination.description: Previous, page numbers and Next, for a long list.

alert-dialog.description: A question that needs an answer before going on.

hover-card.description: A card that appears when the pointer rests on something.

context-menu.description: A menu that opens where something is right-clicked or long-pressed.

scroll-area.description: Scrolling with a thin themed scrollbar; a builder for long lists.

data-table.description: Rows of data under headings: sorting, row selection, and long data built as it scrolls.

sheet.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen.

drawer.description: A panel that comes up from the bottom and drags away, or stays on the page and snaps between heights.

input-group.description: A text field with text, buttons or a toolbar inside its border.

input-otp.description: A one-time code, one character to a box.

resizable.description: Panels with handles between them that drag to resize.

command.description: A search box over a list of things to do, picked with the keyboard.

combobox.description: A select you can search: one pick or several as chips, groups, clearing.

menubar.description: A bar of menus, as at the top of a desktop app.

navigation-menu.description: A site's main links, with panels that open from headings.

carousel.description: Slides moved by swiping, buttons, keys, a controller or by themselves.

selection.description: Selection handles and the cut, copy and paste menu.

calendar.description: Months of days to pick one, several or a range from, with week numbers and dropdowns.

date-picker.description: A button that shows a date and opens a calendar, with presets.

time-picker.description: A button that shows a time and opens columns of hours and minutes, on a 12 or 24-hour clock.

chart.description: Charts made of your rows and the parts you put in them. Bar, line, area, composed and scatter charts with bars, lines, areas, marks, bubbles, prices, boxes, waterfalls and ranges; number, time, category and log axes, several of them; reference lines and bands, annotations, trendlines, a brush, zoom and pan, a crosshair and selection. Histograms, and a table of the values. Drawn here, with no charting package.

pie-chart.description: Slices of a whole: a pie or a donut, rings inside rings, slices drawn out, padded or rounded, with labels inside or outside and a figure in the middle.

radar-chart.description: Several values per series round a circle: polygon or circle grids, filled bands, rings of your choosing, a scale along a spoke, labels of your own, dots and outlines.

radial-chart.description: Values as arcs round a centre: a ring per row or series sharing one ring, round the whole circle or part of it, with a track, a grid, names at the start and a figure in the middle.

sparkline.description: A small chart with no axes for stat cards and table rows: a line, an area, bars or wins and losses, its high, low, first and last values marked, with a band and the value under the pointer.

funnel-chart.description: Steps that narrow: a funnel, each step as wide as its value, or a pyramid, each as tall as its share, with labels and the share of the first step that reached each.

heatmap.description: Values as shades: a grid of cells placed by two fields of your rows (hour by day), and a calendar of days, the way a year of activity is shown.

treemap.description: Parts of a whole as rectangles, each as big as its share and grouped if you like: for when a pie has too many slices.

chart-export.description: A chart, or any widget, as a PNG or a one-page PDF, with no package: the bytes are yours to save, share or upload.

chart-indicators.description: The twelve technical indicators traders read off prices, drawn as series in a chart: simple, exponential, weighted and triangular averages, Bollinger bands, MACD, RSI, stochastic, ATR, accumulation/distribution, momentum and rate of change.

sidebar.description: An app's navigation down the side: variants, submenus, actions, a rail.

form.description: Fields of a form drawn with their labels and errors, checked when it is sent, focus on the first wrong one.

shop-dashboard.description: A shop's day: sales by card and cash, four figures, a chart and the orders to deliver.

clinic.description: A clinic's front desk: branches, sections that fold, and today's appointments.

api-docs.description: API documentation: versions, search, sections that fold, and a page with its code.

staff-handbook.description: A handbook in a floating sidebar, with the page's contents on the right when there is room.

newsroom.description: A newspaper's sections as menus, the morning brief, and the latest stories.

school-office.description: A school office inset as a card: fees collected, who owes most, support at the foot.

support-inbox.description: A support inbox: queues, tickets to pick from, and the conversation with a reply.

field-notes.description: Notes from a farm visit, with a checklist and the page's actions in a popover.

code-review.description: A change under review: the files as a tree, the changed ones above, and the diff.

salon-bookings.description: A salon's day: a month to pick from, who is working, a column of bookings each.

shop-settings.description: Settings in a dialog, their sections down its side.

rent-tracker.description: Rent collected across units, under a header that runs over the sidebar.

phone-sign-in.description: Sign in with a phone number, then the code texted to it.

split-sign-in.description: Sign in on one side, your picture or a customer's word on the other.

account-picker.description: Carry on as an account already used here, or sign in another way.

till-pin.description: Unlock a till: pick who you are, then your PIN on a keypad.

magic-link-sign-in.description: Sign in with an email address alone, by a link sent to it.

phone-sign-up.description: Create an account with a name and a phone number, the terms agreed to.

business-sign-up.description: Open an account for a business, what it gives beside the form.

team-invite.description: Join a team from an invitation: who invited you, then your name and a password.

member-sign-up.description: Become a member in three steps: details, ID, then a PIN.

assistant-chat.description: An assistant's conversation: its thinking, the tools it used, its sources, and an answer that streams in.

wallet.description: A wallet: the balance, what to do with it, and where the money went.

message.description: One turn in a conversation: who sent it, what they said, a line above or below.

bubble.description: What was said, in a rounded fill on the sender's side, with reactions.

marker.description: A note in a conversation that nobody said: a day, someone joining, thinking.

attachment.description: A file or picture in a conversation: what it is and how its upload is going.

markdown.description: Formatted text, drawn as it streams in: headings, lists, tables, quotes, links, and code with a copy button.

prompt-input.description: Where a person writes to an assistant: text that grows, what they attached, your actions, and send that becomes stop.

shimmer.description: Text with a light passing over it, for what is still being worked on.

reasoning.description: What a model thought before answering, folded under a line that says how long it took.

tool-call.description: What an assistant did with one of your tools, or asks to do: where it got to, what went in and came out, approve or deny.

sources.description: What an answer rests on, numbered, and the citation that points to each.

plan.description: The steps an assistant set itself, ticked off as it works.

soundwave.description: How loud a voice is, as a row of bars, from the levels your audio gives.

message-scroller.description: A conversation that scrolls as people expect: new turns near the top, following only at the end.

questionnaire.description: Questions one at a time: one choice, several or words, with keys for every answer.

swipe-actions.description: A row with actions behind it: swipe it aside to show them, all the way to do the first.

pull-to-refresh.description: A list that refreshes when pulled down from its top, with a Refresh action for screen readers.

bottom-bar.description: An app's main places along the bottom of a phone screen, an icon and a name each, or floating in a bar of their own.
